explication: codex-lb pools ChatGPT accounts behind an OpenAI-compatible proxy. A client request enters the proxy, is routed to an eligible pooled account, and is forwarded upstream; account credentials and usage are managed through the dashboard and persisted for reporting and control. The README documents API-key limits, dashboard authentication, model synchronization, and automation capabilities. The graph uses documented product behavior and paths from the tree; sampled excerpts were partial, so uncertain internal call wiring is not asserted.
